cost_unit: elapsed wall-clock microseconds, one warmed process, one sample per route and target

method.route: First verify the calibration Original by discovering stop and building its trace. Fix its token count for every later prediction.
method.reference: Discover stop from scratch and then independently build a complete trace for each target.
method.candidate: Build a full greedy trace once using the fixed predicted length. On a mismatch include the entire attempt and the ordinary reference retry.
method.setup: One warmed model in one process. Report shared model setup and the first calibration separately and with the totals.
method.control: After the main comparisons use calibration length minus one for the first target and include the independent retry.
method.cost_unit: elapsed wall clock microseconds, one comparison per target, three Rayon threads
method.eligibility: historical nonrewarding workload, no adopted cutoff or uncertainty procedure
